Container.Name: machine-hud
Container.Overview:
The Machine HUD: a screen for the OpenJarvis and Cognee containers. Shows Finch and Root, who holds the floor, every interjection, build, aside and raised hand, and a live decision log. The browser never holds a key: this container talks to OpenJarvis and Cognee on jarvis-net with the keys you set here.
Install after OpenJarvis and Cognee. Set HUD_PASSWORD (login) or put it behind tailscale serve with HUD_AUTH=tailscale. HUD_DEMO=1 runs a scripted floor with no upstream and no key, to try the screen first.
Container.Requires: OpenJarvis and Cognee on network jarvis-net. The OpenJarvis API key (from its log or /mnt/cache/appdata/openjarvis/.api_key).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: HUD port. LAN and Tailscale only; do not forward it to the internet.

Config.Name: Vault (read only)
Config.Description: The markdown vault, read-only: memory search, the intake board and council replays read it. The HUD never writes to it; changes go through the sorter in OpenJarvis.

Config.Name: OPENJARVIS_API_KEY
Config.Description: The OpenJarvis API key. Stays in this container; the browser never sees it.

Config.Name: COGNEE_API_KEY
Config.Description: The Cognee API key (from the Cognee log or /mnt/cache/appdata/cognee).

Config.Name: HUD_AUTH
Config.Description: basic: login with HUD_USER and HUD_PASSWORD. tailscale: trust the Tailscale-User-Login header from tailscale serve. off: no login (LAN only). Blank: basic if HUD_PASSWORD is set, else off.

Config.Name: HUD_DEMO
Config.Description: 1: scripted Finch and Root, no upstream calls, no key, no cost.
